item.title: Bipartisan lawmakers unveil new affordability plan
item.description: A bipartisan House caucus unveils an affordability agenda aimed at lowering living costs through housing, health care, energy, and child care reforms.

item.title: Investors betting on steeper yield curve under Warsh-led Fed
item.description: Investors bet on a steeper yield curve as Fed chair nominee Kevin Warsh backs rate cuts while shrinking the Federal Reserve balance sheet.

item.title: Estimates of U.S. housing needs vary widely
item.description: Estimates of America’s housing shortage range from zero to 20 million homes, revealing how affordability, vacancies and policy shape the debate.

item.title: Agency to fund preservation of affordable housing
item.description: Minnesota Housing has selected a slate of properties throughout the state that will receive funding for preservation of naturally occurring affordable housing, according to a press release.

item.title: Kraus-Anderson, Zuri 3 team up for performing arts center project
item.description: Kraus-Anderson and Zuri 3 are teaming up to manage construction of the new Community Performing Arts Center, a planned 8,000-capacity amphitheater operated by the Port of Minneapolis, LLC.

item.title: Minneapolis likely to aid immigration legal services
item.description: Minneapolis City Council approved $500,000 in added funding for the Office of Immigration and Refugee Affairs, with a final vote set for Thursday.

item.title: DLI: Workplace injury, illness rate unchanged in ’24
item.description: Minnesota’s estimated workplace injury and illness rate was unchanged from 2023 to 2024, according to a new report from the Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry.

item.title: Interior designers rethink homes amid aging in place, tech shifts
item.description: Interior designers are adapting homes for aging residents, wellness, and technology as economic, climate, and workforce shifts reshape design trends.

item.title: Endeavor buys land for Fridley redevelopment
item.description: Endeavor Development bought a former Totino’s site in Fridley for $5.85 million and plans a 250,000-square-foot speculative industrial facility.

item.title: Oppidan plans 117,000-square-foot spec industrial in Rogers
item.description: Oppidan Development plans a 117,000-square-foot speculative industrial building in Rogers on a 17-acre site, adding jobs and boosting the tax base.
